gauge-stroke-ratio.$description: ring stroke as a fraction of the ring's diameter: a 170 px ring gets an 8.5 px stroke (ADR-0030 §2.5)

default.$description: marks: dots, chart 'now', peak ticks, delta glyph fill; 2.3:1 on white, so a mark always sits with its value, sign or label, and a mark that alone carries meaning uses accent.700 (4.8:1; visual-dna B3)

accent.$description: the one attention tile; content is ink

inverse.$description: primary pill, active tab, solid action circle

inverse-media.$description: the white solid of visual-dna principle 9 on vivid: Button primary and the active segment when the published material is vivid (ADR-0030 §3.1)

inverse-media-pressed.$description: the white solid over media while pressed: bg.fill.inverse-media one step down the neutral ladder (neutral.0 to 200, OKLab L -0.084), under the same ink (ADR-0039)

inverse-pressed.$description: the inverse solid while pressed: bg.fill.inverse one step up the neutral ladder (neutral.950 to 850, OKLab L +0.084), under the same on-inverse text, so a primary pill or circle shows its press without the scale (ADR-0023 §8.4, ADR-0039)

on-accent-pressed.$description: the solid knocked out on the lit tile, while pressed: the tile's ink, text.on-accent, at 88 %, so 12 % of the tile shows through, under bg.fill.accent as its label; relative to text.on-accent because that follows a brand's text-on-accent slot. Button primary and IconButton primary or selected on an accent surface (ADR-0039 rule 5, ADR-0040 §3.5)

on-inverse-pressed.$description: the solid knocked out on an inverse ground, while pressed: text.on-inverse (neutral.0 in light) one step down the neutral ladder (neutral.0 to 200, OKLab L -0.084), under bg.fill.inverse as its label. Button primary and IconButton primary or selected on an inverse surface (ADR-0039 rule 5, ADR-0040 §3.5)

page.$description: never flat pure grey; optional warm mesh toward #F3F0EB and blooms at 25-35%

default.$description: card: no border, no shadow (optional ambient 5%)

nested.$description: filled control, dock tray (= #F0F1F1 on white)

raised.$description: puffy chip / round button on the page (#F7F8FA, opaque; ADR-0030 §5.2), with color.edge.raised as its top edge and elevation.1; also the glass fallback

critical.$description: the dot step at 12%, so a status wash over a map shows the map through it (ADR-0030 §6.1); a tinted element with text over media paints color.bg.page under it (§6.2)

info.$description: the dot step at 12%, so a status wash over a map shows the map through it (ADR-0030 §6.1); a tinted element with text over media paints color.bg.page under it (§6.2)

success.$description: the dot step at 12%, so a status wash over a map shows the map through it (ADR-0030 §6.1); a tinted element with text over media paints color.bg.page under it (§6.2)

warning.$description: the dot step at 12%, so a status wash over a map shows the map through it (ADR-0030 §6.1); a tinted element with text over media paints color.bg.page under it (§6.2)

on-glass-fill.$description: rings and outlines on the scheme's glass; decorative, next to a label or glyph (ADR-0030 §3.2)

on-media.$description: rings and outlines on vivid; decorative, next to a label or glyph (ADR-0030 §3.2)

now.$description: the now marker; 2.3:1 on white, so it always carries its label or value (visual-dna B3)

line.$description: chart line on the scheme's glass: the glass foreground, ink in light (ADR-0030 §2.3)

plot.$description: the plot on the scheme's glass: a white 8% lift, not a white hole (ADR-0030 §2.3)

reference.$description: the target or reference line on the scheme's glass (ADR-0030 §2.3; ADR-0007 rule 2)
the target or reference line on vivid, told apart from the line by stroke.target's dash (ADR-0030 §2.2; ADR-0007 rule 2)

plot.$description: charts never sit on raw glass

highlight.$description: the glass edge, drawn at the recipe's edge.start and edge.end alphas, and the vivid highlight at material.vivid.edge.* (ADR-0030 §4.1, §4.2)

raised.$description: the 1 px top edge of raised: the puffy chip (ADR-0030 §4.1)

accent.$description: marks only, never text; 2.3:1 on white, so always paired with a value, sign or label (visual-dna B3)

block.$description: map ground: city blocks, over the land

building.$description: map ground: buildings, over the land

label.$description: map labels, with a halo of color.map.land at 2 x border.strong (ADR-0030 §1.4); functional on every ground

land.$description: map ground: the land, the page (ADR-0030 §1.1)

park.$description: map ground: parks, over the land

road.$description: map ground: roads; a major road is road at a wider stroke over road-casing (ADR-0030 §1.3)

road-casing.$description: map ground: the casing under roads

route.$description: the ridden route, 2 x chart.line-width over route-casing (ADR-0030 §1.4)

route-ahead.$description: the route ahead, 1.5 x chart.line-width, dashed with stroke.target (ADR-0030 §1.4)

route-casing.$description: the casing under the route lines, 3.5 x chart.line-width (ADR-0030 §1.4)

water.$description: map ground: water, over the land; hue never carries status on the map (ADR-0030 §1.2)

dimmed.$description: dimmed digits become secondary under Increase Contrast

on-accent-secondary.$description: the lit tile's second tone: on-accent at 70% for the secondary, tertiary and dimmed tones of the accent material (ADR-0030 §3.4)

on-glass.$description: white on dark glass; light glass uses on-glass-light (ADR-0022)

on-glass-fill.$description: the scheme's glass (material.glass.fill and .chip): ink on light glass in light (ADR-0029 §1.3)

on-glass-fill-dimmed.$description: dimmed tone (trailing digits and units at >= 24 px) on the scheme's glass over Prism's map only (backdrop L >= 0.89; ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-fill-media-secondary.$description: secondary tone on the scheme's glass over imagery and vivid: ink, the primary tone, in light (ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-fill-media-tertiary.$description: tertiary and dimmed tones on the scheme's glass over imagery and vivid: ink in light (ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-fill-secondary.$description: secondary tone on the scheme's glass over Prism's map only (backdrop L >= 0.84; ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-fill-tertiary.$description: tertiary tone on the scheme's glass over Prism's map only (ADR-0029 §1.4)

on-glass-light.$description: ink on light glass in the light scheme; hierarchy by size, never by alpha (ADR-0022 §3)

on-glass-secondary.$description: secondary tone on dark glass (the glass material) only; chips and cells use on-glass (ADR-0022 §3)

on-glass-tertiary.$description: tertiary and dimmed tones on dark glass (the glass material) only (ADR-0022 §3)

on-inverse-media.$description: ink on the white solid over vivid (bg.fill.inverse-media; ADR-0030 §3.1)

on-vivid.$description: every vivid gradient, the nine reference gradients included, passes ADR-0022 V1/V2

weight.$description: regular; maps to Phosphor regular / SF regular (spec/icons/registry.json)

default.$description: status cells over a render or vivid; smoked fill, primary foreground text.on-glass only; a 1.5 px status border carries the status (ADR-0022)
the scheme's glass for chips, controls and status cells over media; aliases glass.light.chip field by field (ADR-0029 §1.2)
controls over a photo, map or vivid; primary foreground text.on-glass only (ADR-0022 §3)
card or drawer over a photo or vivid, on backdrops where white holds 3:1 (ADR-0022 §3.3); drawer 0.35
the scheme's glass: Surface glass and Card glass over maps, imagery and vivid; aliases glass.light.fill field by field (ADR-0029 §1.2)
chips, pills, rows over vivid; tab bar 0.45; ink text (text.on-glass-light); only over vivid or imagery at OKLCH L >= 0.45 (ADR-0022)

scrim.$description: bottom-up under text on unpredictable backdrops: large white text holds 3:1 over it on pure white (ADR-0029 §1.7); maps need no scrim

end.$description: alpha of color.edge.highlight at the end of a vivid surface's inner edge (ADR-0030 §4.2)

start.$description: alpha of color.edge.highlight at the start of a vivid surface's 1 px inner edge (ADR-0030 §4.2)

crossfade.$description: Flag. 1 under Reduce Motion: outside an active gesture nothing scales, rotates, blurs or changes depth; presentations fade by opacity over motion.duration.base with motion.easing.out; in-place movement keeps its spring (ADR-0023 §8.4).

min.$description: minimum card width in pattern grids (spec/patterns/README.md)

font-family.$description: the hero numeral; the watch platform context uses ref.type.metric.xl-watch (ADR-0030 §7.2)

font-size.$description: the hero numeral; the watch platform context uses ref.type.metric.xl-watch (ADR-0030 §7.2)

font-weight.$description: the hero numeral; the watch platform context uses ref.type.metric.xl-watch (ADR-0030 §7.2)

line-height.$description: the hero numeral; the watch platform context uses ref.type.metric.xl-watch (ADR-0030 §7.2)

letter-spacing.$description: the hero numeral; the watch platform context uses ref.type.metric.xl-watch (ADR-0030 §7.2)

fill.$description: the wash under a cumulative area or between a range pair; Prism's charts carry bands, not area gradients, so the area reuses the one chart wash (docs/research/visual-dna.md §8.2, §8.3 item 4)

bg.$description: the circle behind the initials and the fallback glyph; raised rather than nested because color.text.secondary is checked on color.bg.surface.raised and on no nested ground (ADR-0011 rule 1); over media the circle takes material.glass.chip instead

ring.$description: the active or selected avatar's stroke: the inverse solid as a ring (visual-dna principle 9); over media it becomes color.border.on-media

bg.$description: the one attention fill per screen; the accent means look here, never an action
the solid danger disc; solid red exists only in the badge and the alert glyph (visual-dna 4.11)

text.$description: 11 px Medium digits on the badge red

bg.$description: the neutral count is the inverse solid: ink on light, white on dark (visual-dna principle 9)

pressed.$description: the ghost is outlined and transparent at rest; pressed takes the neutral subtle fill (ADR-0029 §3.3)
the pressed pill: one lightness step from the rest fill, so a press shows with no scale under Reduce Motion (ADR-0039); on vivid the spec binds color.bg.fill.inverse-media-pressed

rest.$description: solid inverse pill is the only fill

selected.$description: a checked box is the inverse solid; unchecked has no fill at all (ADR-0029 §3.3)

mark.$description: the check or the mixed dash on the filled box: the opposite-colored glyph

radius.$description: the smallest container radius, so the square reads as a square beside a radio's circle (visual-dna §1 principle 2)

size.$description: the box is the glyph box a control carries, 20 px (visual-dna §1 principle 13); the hit region is size.hit around it

rest.$description: the chip is a raised pill on solid grounds; over media it takes material.glass.chip instead
decorative: the fill step and the label identify the chip, so the stroke is not the boundary role

selected.$description: selection is a full-strength stroke and label, never a solid fill

icon.$description: the critical text step, not the mark step: it is the pair the contrast gate checks on the critical tint

pressed.$description: the hairline ring is transparent at rest; pressed takes the neutral subtle fill (ADR-0029 §3.3)

border.$description: the ring alone identifies the control, so it is the boundary tier (ADR-0011)

icon.$description: the bare corner glyph: no fill, no ring, the same tone Card gives its open affordance

pressed.$description: the pressed circle, selected or not: one lightness step from the rest fill, so a press shows with no scale under Reduce Motion (ADR-0039); over media the spec binds color.bg.fill.inverse-media-pressed

rest.$description: the one solid circle in a group; selection renders this cell too (visual-dna §1 principle 9)

icon.$description: the opposite-colored glyph on the solid circle

border.$description: the optional 1 px top edge of a raised puck; decorative, the fill carries the step

pressed.$description: the pressed row: one step up the luminance ladder, never a scale, because a row is the width of its container

selected.$description: the leading rule of the selected row: the one active element of a group is the inverse solid (visual-dna §1 principle 9); a sub-item's rule takes color.border.strong instead

bg.$description: the current page in the expanded pointer layout: the one solid among plain numbers (visual-dna §1 principle 9); over media the spec binds color.bg.fill.inverse-media instead

text.$description: the current page's number on its solid fill

bg.$description: the pill of the place the reader is in: the one inverse solid of the row (visual-dna §1 principle 9, §4.7)

text.$description: the label and the leading glyph of the active tab in the pill variant, on comp.pill-tabs.active.bg. The underline variant draws no fill, so it does not use this token: its active label is sys.color.text.primary, the ink of the ground it sits on. The pair color.text.on-inverse on color.bg.fill.inverse is checked in tokens/contrast-pairs.json

underline.$description: the 2 px rule under the active label of the underline variant; it is ink, not a border tone, because a boundary role at 3:1 would read as a divider rather than as the mark of where the reader is

fill.$description: the filled length is the inverse solid (ink in light, white in dark); the accent means attention, never progress (visual-dna §1 principles 3 and 9)

fill-secondary.$description: the second length of a split bar: the comparison weight, so the two parts differ by intensity of one ink and not by hue (dataviz-design.md §3 E26)

height.$description: 4 px: the minimum gauge stroke of dataviz-design.md §3 E25, and one step of the 4 px rhythm (visual-dna §6.1)

marker-height.$description: 8 px: the target tick is twice the track's thickness, the comparative marker of dataviz-design.md §3 E27, centred on the track's centreline

track.$description: the unfilled pill: the neutral subtle fill, one quiet step over the surface ladder rather than a grey of its own

arc.$description: the value arc is the inverse solid (ink in light, white in dark); the accent means attention, never progress (visual-dna §1 principles 3 and 9)

stroke-min.$description: 4 px: the floor under chart.gauge-stroke-ratio, from dataviz-design.md §3 E25's minimum ring stroke

track.$description: the unfilled circumference: the neutral subtle fill, one quiet step over the surface ladder rather than a grey of its own (dataviz-design.md §3 E25)

selected.$description: the chosen circle is the inverse solid; the others have no fill at all (ADR-0029 §3.3)

fill.$description: the opposite-colored dot on the solid circle

size.$description: 8 px, the button-icon-gap step of the 4 px rhythm (visual-dna §6.1); a dot, not a glyph
the circle is the glyph box a control carries, 20 px (visual-dna §1 principle 13); the hit region is size.hit around it

lg.$description: ring as a card's hero instrument; the largest diameter on Prism's space rhythm (docs/research/visual-dna.md §6.1, §6.6)

md.$description: ring inside a card, the 64 px step of docs/research/dataviz-design.md §5

sm.$description: glanceable ring: the corner ring diameter of the card anatomy, and the watch complication size (docs/research/dataviz-design.md §5)

bg.$description: the selected segment is the one inverse solid in the group (visual-dna principle 9); unselected segments have no fill

text.$description: the label and glyph on the selected segment

error.$description: the invalid outline of the trigger; the critical stroke is the critical text role

bg.$description: the destination the reader is in: the one inverse solid of the rail, against bare rows for every other item (visual-dna §1 principle 9)

text.$description: the label and the glyph of the active destination; the pair color.text.on-inverse on color.bg.fill.inverse is checked in tokens/contrast-pairs.json

width.$description: the width of the icon rail; space.12 is the references' 64 px icon-rail gutter (visual-dna §6.1, §6.4), which the role's number does not say

bg.$description: the placeholder body: the neutral subtle fill, one step of the luminance ladder and never a grey of its own (visual-dna §1 principle 1)

shimmer.$description: the travelling pass: a second neutral subtle layer over the body, so the sweep never brightens past the next step of the ladder; it is not drawn under Reduce Motion (ADR-0023 §8.4)

fill.$description: the filled part of the track is the one solid in the control (visual-dna §1 principle 9)
the same ink as the fill; the thumb is told by its size, not by its color

size.$description: the small control circle, so the thumb sits in the one control family and never falls below the pointer hit area (ADR-0024 §7.1)

tick.$description: the step marks under the track; the tick-ruler ornament of visual-dna §4.12, always decorative

bg.$description: the unfilled part of the meter: a lighter step of the same ink/white ramp as the fill (dataviz-design §3), and the boundary-tier token the contrast gate already checks

height.$description: 4 px, the smallest step of the 4 px rhythm (visual-dna §6.1); the references give no track thickness of their own

table.$description: sparkline height in a table row: the row's text line box (docs/research/dataviz-design.md §3 rule D20, §6)

tile.$description: sparkline height in a stat tile or a card aside: twice the table height (docs/research/visual-dna.md §8.4, dataviz-design.md §3 rule D20)

arc.$description: the turning arc is a glyph, not a fill: it takes the primary icon colour unless the owning control binds the part itself (Button binds its own foreground per variant)

stroke.$description: 1.5 px: the icon stroke of visual-dna §10, so the arc weighs the same as the glyph it replaces

rule.$description: the leading rule of a selected row: the inverse solid, as ListRow's selection rule is (visual-dna §1 principle 9). It sits on the row's neutral selection overlay, where color.border.strong falls below 3:1 over a raised panel in both schemes; the pair color.bg.fill.inverse on color.bg.fill.neutral.subtle is checked in tokens/contrast-pairs.json

error.$description: the invalid outline of the multi-line box; the critical stroke is the critical text role
the invalid outline; the critical stroke is the critical text role, as it is on the danger button

bg.$description: the marker of the one entry that is "now": the single inverse solid of the list, against hairline rings for every other entry (visual-dna §1 principle 9, §4.13)

icon.$description: the glyph inside the current marker; the pair color.text.on-inverse on color.bg.fill.inverse is checked in tokens/contrast-pairs.json

height.$description: the track is the small control height, so a toggle sits in the one control family (ADR-0024 §7.1)

inset.$description: the gap between the knob and the track edge; the smallest step of the 4 px rhythm (visual-dna §6.1)

off.$description: the quiet dot inside the outlined track; the color.text.secondary ramp step

on.$description: the opposite-colored element on the solid track

off.$description: off is an outlined track over a neutral subtle well; the outline is color.border.strong

on.$description: on is the inverse solid: the binary form of the one-solid-per-group rule (visual-dna §1 principle 9)

bg.$description: the chip is the inverse solid, so one transient label reads at full contrast over any layer it floats above, including imagery and vivid (visual-dna §1 principle 9, §4.7)

text.$description: the label on the inverse chip; the pair color.text.on-inverse on color.bg.fill.inverse is checked in tokens/contrast-pairs.json

height.$description: the height of the top row; space.11 is the references' 48 px header row (visual-dna §6.1, §6.4), which the role's number does not say
